nuggets.text: DeMeco Ryans' 2025 Texans became the second team in NFL history to reach the Divisional Round after an 0-3 start.
Texans coach DeMeco Ryans was drafted by Houston in 2006 and won AP Defensive Rookie of the Year that season.
The Texans beat the Cowboys in their first game in 2002, the first expansion team to win its opener since 1961.
The Texans won the first road playoff game in franchise history in January 2026.
The Texans set a franchise record with a 10-game winning streak last season.
The Texans play in Reliant Stadium again this season, the name it carried from 2002 until it became NRG in 2014.
The Texans' home was the first NFL stadium built with a retractable roof.
At Texans home games, the announcer says a player's first name and the crowd yells out the last name.
C.J. Stroud is the youngest quarterback in NFL history to win a playoff game.
In April, Will Anderson Jr. signed an extension that made him the NFL's highest-paid non-quarterback.
